pr.title: fix(conport): UUID-safe recursive CTE traversal for workspace_relationships, depth 1-3
pr.body: Rewrites the workspace_relationships handler in enhanced_server.py (~lines 1993-2038) to traverse public.entity_relationships via a recursive CTE without int() coercion on UUID decision IDs. Removes the ValueError-causing int(decision_id) cast at approximately line 2024. Adds depth parameter (1-3) with 422 on out-of-range. Updates unified_queries.py if the CTE logic is factored there. Adds regression tests for depth-1, depth-2, depth-3 traversal and confirms no ValueError or 500 on UUID IDs.
